build_summary: Recovery Room artefact implements the Signal Garden experience as specified. LoadingState renders a determinate progress bar with ARIA label 'Loading signal garden, please wait' and role='progressbar'; reduced-motion media query replaces it with static text 'Loading...'. ReadyState renders three signal strands (Feature Adoption: 29.08% current / 41.04% previous, Active Users: 120 current / 141 previous, Session Frequency: 4.85 current / 3.77 previous) and a seat utilisation card (75.95%), each bound to exact evidence keys. ActiveInspection expands strands on focus to show tooltips with citation text and renders the open support case detail (reference: support:copper-finch:2-1, sentiment: -0.267, status: unresolved as of 2026-07-27) when relevant. ClarificationModal renders with role='dialog', aria-modal='true', optional observation text area (not required), and explicit 'Share observation' and 'Not now' buttons; focus is trapped and modal announces purpose. SuccessState renders acknowledgment banner with role='status', aria-live='polite', message 'Thank you for exploring your signal garden. Your team's patterns are yours to act on—or not.', and respects reduced-motion preferences.

experience_definition.name: Signal Garden
experience_definition.customer_promise: Inspect your team's usage signals without pressure, and choose whether to explore workflow clarity.

regions.implemented_behavior: Displays aggregate signal strands and seat utilisation card as inspect-only objects; each strand binds to evidence keys and shows exact current/previous values; focus order proceeds through canvas to persistent exit and page navigation; contrast ratios meet WCAG 2.2 AA; reduced-motion media query replaces expansion animation with instant state shift.

Captures purpose-limited observation about workflow friction; modal has role='dialog' and aria-modal='true'; observation field is not required and has no default value; 'Share observation' button triggers API call only on explicit click; 'Not now' button or escape/overlay click dismisses modal without side effects; reduced-motion media query disables modal animation.

Thanks customer for engagement without prescribing action; banner has role='status' and aria-live='polite'; message contains no persuasion, urgency, or next-step suggestion; respects reduced-motion preferences with static fallback.

state_transitions.customer_control: via click, keyboard, or screen reader on any signal strand
explicit button click opens modal; inspection state remains active

state_transitions.event: modal dismissed via 'Not now' or escape/overlay
observation shared via explicit 'Share observation' click

communicator_handoff.audience: Account holders of Copper Finch who have received the email invitation
communicator_handoff.customer_value: Enables self-paced, pressure-free inspection of aggregate usage patterns and optional, consent-gated sharing of workflow observations to inform product understanding.

supported_claims.claim: Customers can inspect their team's Feature Adoption signal showing a current value of 29.08% and previous value of 41.04%.
supported_claims.qualification: Value is sourced directly from the cited evidence key; no interpretation or calculation is applied.

supported_claims.claim: Customers can inspect their team's Active Users signal showing a current value of 120 and previous value of 141.
supported_claims.qualification: Value is sourced directly from the cited evidence key; no interpretation or calculation is applied.

supported_claims.claim: Customers can inspect their team's Session Frequency signal showing a current value of 4.85 and previous value of 3.77.
supported_claims.qualification: Value is sourced directly from the cited evidence key; no interpretation or calculation is applied.

supported_claims.claim: Customers can inspect their team's Seat Utilisation signal showing a value of 75.95%.
supported_claims.qualification: Value is sourced directly from the cited evidence key; no interpretation or calculation is applied.

supported_claims.claim: Customers can inspect an open medium-severity workflow support case with reference support:copper-finch:2-1, sentiment -0.267, and status unresolved as of 2026-07-27.
supported_claims.qualification: Detail is sourced directly from the cited evidence key; no interpretation or inference is applied.

supported_claims.claim: The clarification request is optional and not required to proceed; customers may choose 'Not now' or dismiss the modal without consequence.
supported_claims.qualification: Modal behavior requires explicit button activation for entry and explicit 'Share observation' for data persistence; decline paths are honored without side effects.

supported_claims.claim: After engaging with signals or closing the clarification modal, customers see an acknowledgment banner stating: 'Thank you for exploring your signal garden. Your team's patterns are yours to act on—or not.'
supported_claims.qualification: Banner is rendered with role='status' and aria-live='polite'; message contains no persuasion, urgency, or suggested next step.

required_disclosures: The experience uses only the email channel for outreach, as permitted by the preference profile.
No data from signal inspection is stored, used for profiling, or persisted without explicit consent to share an observation.
The observation sharing is explicit, purpose-limited to improving the signal garden, and not required to proceed.
All aggregate signals are account-level observations; they are not personal, individual, user-level, diagnostic, or causal explanations for any change.
The experience respects WCAG 2.2 AA standards for contrast, focus, keyboard navigation, screen-reader access, and reduced motion.
A decline at any point (email non-engagement, 'Not now' in modal, or modal dismiss) is a complete and valid outcome with no implied obligation or follow-up.

residual_risks.risk: Customer may perceive signal inspection as judgment despite neutral framing.
residual_risks.control: Signal strands are labelled as observational data with explicit 'No action required' messaging; tone is curious, not corrective.

residual_risks.risk: Optional clarification could feel like a soft sell.
residual_risks.control: Clarification request is framed as helping improve the signal garden itself, not the product; observation field is optional and not required to proceed.
